name: 屈膝前倾坐姿
promptEn: Sit with both knees drawn high toward the chest and the feet close together below. Lean the torso forward, turn the head slightly toward the camera with the chin lowered, and reach both arms down between the shins. Let one hand extend loosely near the ankle while the other overlaps it with gently curled fingers. Keep the knees at slightly different heights and preserve the natural asymmetry.
promptZh: 坐姿，双膝抬高靠近胸前，双脚在下方并拢；上身前倾，头部略转向镜头并微收下巴。双臂从小腿之间向下伸，一手在脚踝附近自然展开，另一手轻松弯指与其交叠；双膝略有高低差，保持自然的不对称姿态。

name: 屈膝抬头捏指坐姿
promptEn: Sit with both knees raised in front of the torso and the feet close together. Tilt the head back and lift the chin toward the upper left of the frame. Bend the arm on the left of the frame upward, supporting the elbow near the knee, with the thumb and index finger forming a small pinch near the mouth and the remaining fingers curled. Extend the other arm down between the legs, leaving its hand loosely curved near the ankle.
promptZh: 坐姿，双膝抬起置于身前，双脚并拢；头部后仰，下巴朝画面左上方抬起。画面左侧的手臂向上弯曲，肘部靠近膝盖支撑，拇指和食指在嘴边做轻捏手势，其余手指自然弯曲；另一条手臂从双腿之间向下伸，手掌在脚踝附近放松弯曲。

name: 抬手扶眼镜坐姿
promptEn: Sit with the torso leaning slightly back and both knees bent at different heights. Keep the knee on the left of the frame higher and its foot slightly raised, while the nearer foot rests lower in the foreground. Bend the arm on the left of the frame outward and upward, bringing the thumb and index finger to the upper outer corner of the worn glasses. Extend the other arm diagonally down and back for support, with relaxed curled fingers. Tilt the head slightly and preserve the finger-to-frame contact.
promptZh: 坐姿，上身略向后倾，双膝弯曲并保持高低差；画面左侧的膝盖较高，脚略抬起，近侧的脚落在更低的前景。画面左侧手臂向外抬起并屈肘，拇指与食指轻扶佩戴眼镜的外侧上角；另一条手臂斜向后下方伸出作支撑，手指放松弯曲。头部轻微侧倾，保留指尖与镜框的接触。

name: 抱膝双手持瓶坐姿
promptEn: Sit compactly with both knees together near the chest and both feet close together below. Lean slightly forward and turn the head a little toward the left of the frame while wearing glasses. Bend both elbows and hold a capped beverage bottle almost upright between the chest and knees, with the cap just beneath the chin. One hand wraps higher around the bottle while the other crosses in front lower down; preserve the finger overlap and bottle-to-chin contact.
promptZh: 蜷坐，双膝并拢抬至胸前，双脚在下方靠拢；身体略向前倾，头部稍转向画面左侧，佩戴眼镜。双肘弯曲，两手在胸前与膝盖之间握住一只近乎竖直的带盖饮料瓶，瓶盖轻抵下巴；一手握住瓶身较高处，另一手在较低处从前方交叠，保留手指遮挡与瓶盖接触位置。

name: 侧倾单手持瓶坐姿
promptEn: A close seated pose with the torso reclining toward the right of the frame and the head tilted slightly the other way. Cross the thighs in the foreground, with the lower legs outside the crop. Bend the arm on the left of the frame and raise a capped beverage bottle near the lower face, its axis angled diagonally upward to the right. Wrap four fingers over the bottle and support it with the thumb underneath. Extend the other arm diagonally down to the right, with its hand outside the crop.
promptZh: 坐姿近景，上身向画面右侧斜倚，头部略向反方向侧倾；双腿在前景交叠，小腿与脚处于画外。画面左侧手臂屈肘，单手举起带盖饮料瓶靠近脸部下方，瓶身轴线斜向右上方，四指弯曲包握瓶身、拇指从下方承托；另一条手臂斜向右下方伸出，手掌位于画外。

name: 侧倾双手比心站姿
promptEn: Stand with the hips shifted toward the left of the frame and the torso leaning to the right, while the head tilts gently back toward the left. Bend both elbows outward and raise the forearms inward, forming an open heart shape with both hands in front of the upper chest. Touch the fingertips at the upper and lower points of the heart, keeping the other fingers naturally curled and the two hands slightly asymmetrical. Frame from the head to the thighs.
promptZh: 站姿，胯部向画面左侧偏移，上身向右侧倾斜，头部轻轻向左侧回倾；双肘向外弯曲，前臂向内抬起，两手在胸前上方围出心形。指尖分别在心形的上端与下端相接，其余手指自然弯曲，保持两手轻微的不对称与清晰的指间分界；构图从头部至大腿。

name: 盘腿抬手坐姿
promptEn: Sit cross-legged with the torso upright and leaning slightly forward. Stack the bent legs asymmetrically in the foreground, with the nearer shin crossing diagonally from the upper-left knee toward the lower-right foot. Tilt the head slightly down and toward the left of the frame. Raise the hand on the left of the frame near the mouth, lightly pinching a thin snack stick between the thumb and index finger while the other fingers curl naturally. Bend the other arm beside the waist, keeping its hand in a loose curved grip.
promptZh: 盘腿坐姿，上身基本直立并略向前倾；双腿在前景自然交叠，近侧小腿从画面左上方的膝盖斜向右下方的脚，两条腿与双脚保持前后遮挡。头部略低并转向画面左侧；画面左侧的手抬至嘴边，拇指和食指轻捏细长零食棒，其余手指自然弯曲。另一条手臂在腰侧屈肘，手掌保持放松的弯曲握持姿态。

name: 低头屈膝后倚坐姿
promptEn: Sit with the torso reclining slightly and both knees raised at different heights in the foreground. Turn the head toward the right of the frame and lower the chin. Extend the arm on the left of the frame diagonally downward out of the crop; keep the other arm close beside the torso, with its forearm partly hidden behind the lower knee on the right. Keep both hands and feet out of view, preserving the knee overlap and foreshortened legs.
promptZh: 坐姿，上身略向后倚，双膝在前景抬起并保持高低差；头部转向画面右侧，微低头收下巴。画面左侧手臂斜向下伸至画外，另一条手臂贴近躯干，前臂部分被画面右侧较低的膝盖遮挡。双手与双脚均不可见，保留膝盖的前后遮挡及腿部透视缩短。

name: 展臂垂手交叠腿坐姿
promptEn: Sit with both upper arms spread widely to the sides and the elbows bent, allowing the forearms and hands to hang down. Keep the hand on the left of the frame relaxed with fingers hanging at different heights, and the other hand loosely curled. Lower the chin and tilt the head slightly toward the right of the frame. Cross the thighs in the foreground, with the nearer thigh running toward the right knee and its shin descending through the bottom crop; the other leg continues diagonally behind it. Keep the feet outside the frame and preserve the natural asymmetry of the arms and hands.
promptZh: 坐姿，双上臂向两侧展开，屈肘让前臂和双手自然下垂；画面左侧手指放松垂落、长短错开，另一只手轻松弯指。微收下巴，头部略向画面右侧倾斜。双腿在前景交叠，近侧大腿伸向右侧膝盖，小腿向下延伸至画外；另一条腿从后方斜向右下。双脚不入镜，保留手臂与双手自然的不对称。

name: 展臂侧头半身坐姿
promptEn: A close seated portrait viewed slightly from above. Recline the torso gently, spread both upper arms outward through the side edges, and keep the shoulder on the left of the frame lower than the other. Tilt and turn the head slightly toward the right of the frame, with the chin lifted toward the camera. Keep the top of the head touching the upper crop. A large bent knee enters from the lower right and overlaps the lower torso, with a smaller fragment of the farther leg at the right edge. Keep both forearms, hands and feet outside the crop.
promptZh: 略带俯视的坐姿半身近景，上身轻轻后倚，双上臂向两侧展开并伸出画外，画面左肩低于右肩。头部略向画面右侧转动并侧倾，下巴微抬朝向镜头，头顶贴近画面上缘。弯曲的膝盖从右下方进入前景，遮挡躯干下部，远侧腿只在右缘露出一小部分；前臂、双手和双脚均位于画外。

name: 展臂垂手侧坐姿
promptEn: Sit in a three-quarter side view with the torso reclining and the hips angled toward the lower right of the frame. Turn the head toward the right and lower the chin slightly. Extend the arm on the left of the frame outward, bend its elbow near the left edge, and let the forearm descend diagonally to a relaxed hanging hand with individually curved fingers. Keep the other arm mostly hidden behind the torso. Raise the nearer thigh diagonally toward the right edge, with the farther leg visible as a narrower fragment above it. Keep the knees and feet outside the right-side crop.
promptZh: 四分之三侧坐，上身后倚，胯部斜向画面右下方；头部转向右侧，下巴略收。画面左侧上臂向外展开，在左缘附近屈肘，前臂斜向下伸，手掌自然下垂，手指分别放松弯曲。另一条手臂大部分藏在躯干后方。近侧大腿斜向右侧抬起，远侧腿在其上方露出较窄的一段；膝盖与双脚均位于右侧画外。

name: 单臂展开弯指站姿
promptEn: Stand with the weight shifted to one hip and the thighs gently overlapping. Tilt the head toward the right of the frame and lower the chin slightly. Extend the arm on the left of the frame outward at shoulder height, bending the forearm upward toward a hand partly cut off by the left edge. Keep the other upper arm near the torso, bend its elbow and raise the forearm diagonally to the right, with the palm facing upward and the fingers delicately curled. Preserve the separated thumb, overlapping curled fingers, wrist bend and natural asymmetry. Frame from the head to the thighs, with the feet outside the image.
promptZh: 站姿，重心偏向一侧胯部，双腿在大腿处轻微交叠；头部偏向画面右侧，下巴略低。画面左侧手臂在肩高向外展开，前臂屈起朝左上方伸，手掌部分被左缘裁切。另一侧上臂贴近躯干，屈肘将前臂斜向右上方抬起，掌心朝上、手指轻轻弯曲。保留拇指分离、弯曲手指的交叠和手腕角度，保持自然的不对称；构图从头部至大腿，双脚位于画外。

name: 屈肘托颊近景
promptEn: A close portrait pose with the head turned three-quarters toward the left of the frame and leaning beside a raised forearm. Bend one arm upward from the lower-left edge, bringing the forearm diagonally across the lower face and the curved hand beside the cheek. Keep the other shoulder and the original tight crop visible.
promptZh: 近景，头部三分之四朝向画面左侧并靠近抬起的前臂；一侧手臂从画面左下方屈肘抬起，前臂斜向上经过面部下方，弯曲的手掌靠近脸颊。保留另一侧肩部的可见范围和紧凑裁切。

name: 交叠腿扶胯站姿
promptEn: Stand facing forward with the hips shifted slightly and the knees crossed. Let one hand rest beside the left hip while the other hangs against the outer thigh. Keep the arms asymmetrical and both feet visible.
promptZh: 站姿，身体基本朝前，胯部略向一侧偏移，双腿在膝下交叠；一只手放在左侧胯旁，另一只手自然垂在大腿外侧。保留双臂的不对称和双脚位置。

name: 侧倾头肩近景
promptEn: A tight head-and-shoulders portrait. Tilt the head slightly and turn it a little to one side. Keep the shoulders asymmetrical and preserve the close crop; no hands are visible.
promptZh: 头肩近景，头部轻微侧倾并略向一侧转动；双肩保持不对称，保留紧凑裁切，画面中没有手部。

name: 单手扶胯转体站姿
promptEn: Stand with the weight shifted to one hip, the torso nearly facing forward and the head slightly tilted. Bend one arm so the hand rests on the outer hip or upper thigh while the other arm stays partly hidden. Keep the thighs gently angled and preserve the upper-thigh crop.
promptZh: 站姿，重心偏向一侧胯部，上身基本朝前，头部略微侧倾；一侧屈臂将手放在胯部外侧或大腿上方，另一侧手臂部分隐藏。双腿保持轻微斜向，并保留大腿上部的裁切。

name: 低头侧转头肩近景
promptEn: A tight head-and-shoulders pose with the chin lowered and the head turned slightly to one side. Keep the neck and shoulders at their original angles, with the hands outside the crop.
promptZh: 头肩近景，下巴微收，头部略向一侧转动；保留颈部和双肩的角度，双手位于画外。

name: 侧面抬手触头近景
promptEn: A tight side-profile pose facing left, with the chin slightly lowered. Raise one hand from the left edge to touch the side of the head; only part of the hand and wrist remains in frame. Preserve the small crop and shoulder angle.
promptZh: 侧面近景，头部朝向画面左侧，下巴略收；一只手从左缘抬起触碰头侧，手掌和手腕仅部分入镜。保留紧凑裁切与肩部角度。

name: 单臂扶胯交叠腿站姿
promptEn: Stand with the torso facing forward and one hip shifted. Bend one arm so the hand rests near the hip while the other hand hangs at the upper thigh. Cross the legs gently below the knees and keep both feet in view.
promptZh: 站姿，上身朝前并将重心移向一侧胯部；一侧屈臂将手放在胯旁，另一只手自然垂在大腿上方。双腿在膝下轻轻交叠，双脚保持入镜。

name: 单膝抬起倚坐姿
promptEn: Sit slightly reclined on a seat. Raise one bent knee into the foreground and fold the lower leg down toward its visible foot; keep the other leg close to the seat and partly obscured. Let the arm on the left of the frame extend outward and down with relaxed fingers, while the other arm hangs beside the torso. Preserve the slight head tilt, asymmetric shoulders, leg foreshortening and original crop.
promptZh: 坐姿，身体略向后倚；一侧屈膝抬至前景，小腿向下折向可见的脚部，另一条腿贴近座面并部分遮挡。画面左侧手臂向外下方伸展、手指放松，另一侧手臂沿躯干垂下。保留头部轻微侧倾、肩线不对称、腿部透视缩短与原始裁切。

name: 屈膝抬腿单腿站姿
promptEn: Stand with the weight on one nearly straight leg. Lift the other thigh forward and outward, bend the knee, and fold the lower leg back across the standing leg, with the foot behind. Let both arms hang close to the torso, preserving their asymmetry and relaxed hands. Keep the head tilt, foot angles, crop and leg overlap.
promptZh: 站姿，重心落在一条近乎伸直的支撑腿上；另一侧大腿向前并向外抬起，屈膝后让小腿向后折过支撑腿前方，脚部留在后侧。双臂贴近躯干自然下垂，保留手部放松与两侧不对称。保留头部倾斜、脚部角度、原始裁切和腿部遮挡。

name: 侧坐屈膝单臂支撑姿
promptEn: Sit sideways on a raised surface and lean the torso back. Place one hand down and outward to support the body while bending the other arm and lifting its hand beside the head. Fold both legs in front, with the nearer thigh projecting across the frame and its lower leg descending toward the bottom crop; keep the farther leg partly behind. Preserve the head angle, arm asymmetry, foreshortening and overlaps.
promptZh: 侧坐在较高的座面上，上身向后倚；一只手向外下方撑住身体，另一侧屈臂，将手抬至头侧。双腿在身前屈起，近侧大腿横向伸入画面，小腿朝下方画缘延伸，远侧腿部分藏在后方。保留头部角度、双臂不对称、透视缩短与前后遮挡。
